rationale: JLS 15.13 — the first operand of a method reference is an ExpressionName or a ReferenceType, and neither a method invocation nor a string literal is one. The analyzer named the receiver with extractJavaTypeBaseName, which returns the node's OWN TEXT for anything that is not a generic_type/scoped_type_identifier, so a receiver that is not a type produced an edge whose target was a CALL or a quoted STRING. Measured on the whole corpus: references -> "newArrayList(v3(), v4())" x2 (guava-testlib MultimapPutIterableTester.java L51/L64), references -> "\"com.google.common.\"" x2 (guava-tests WriteReplaceOverridesTest.java L59), references -> "StandardTable.this" x2 (guava StandardTable.java L808/L883). These survived the production path — pool-worker's filterNoiseRelationships bans {} backticks angle brackets and newlines in a target leaf, and a call's text carries none. Positive half: the shapes that ARE names must keep emitting, including the `identifier` shape the differential's references oracle audits (1000 of 1117 corpus method_reference nodes), so a fix that removed the fabrication cannot quietly remove the audited behaviour instead. Negative half: no references edge may name a shape that contains whitespace, a bracket, a quote or a `.this` leaf.
